 Harris County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0004
 Thomas Anderson, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Oral Deposition of Thomas Anderson
Date:
October 26, 2025
Location:
Offices of Gardner & Morris Law Group
Examining attorney:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defending attorney:
Garrett Wallace, Gardner & Morris Law Group
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the record. I'm the plaintiff in this matter, so you already have it in the filings.
Q: Fair enough. Let's go over the accident. Where were you when it happened?
A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Pearland, Texas. I had just pulled into a space near the grocery store entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was backing out of the space to leave. I checked my mirror and I saw nothing coming, so I started reversing slowly.
Q: What happened next?
A: A pickup truck came down the aisle, faster than you'd expect for a parking lot. It hit the rear passenger side of my car. The
impact spun my car partly around and pushed me back against the seat.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle?
A: Yes, once I could get my door open. The other driver was already out, and we talked for a few minutes while people walked
past.
Q: When did you first notice pain?
A: Not right away. I felt fine at the scene, just shaken. By that evening my lower back was tight, and by the next morning it was a
sharp ache that got worse when I bent over or sat too long.
Q: Who treated you after the accident?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the following day. They took X-rays, prescribed muscle relaxers and an anti-inflammatory, and
told me to rest and see a physical therapist.
Q: Have you been going to physical therapy?
A: Yes, I've been going about twice a week. The exercises help some days more than others. My therapist has me working on
core strength and stretching.
Q: How has the injury affected your daily life?
A: It's affected a lot. I used to coach my nephew's soccer team on weekends, and I've had to hand that off to my brother. Driving
longer than twenty or thirty mniutes is uncomfortable, and I can't lift our grocery bags without my back catching.
Q: Have you missed any work?
A: I missed about a week in the first few days after the accident. Since then I've been working at my desk, but I stand up often
and I can't sit through long meetings the way I used to.
Q: Do you have any prior problems with your lower back?
A: I had a minor strain years ago from moving furniture, but it resolved with a few weeks of rest. Before this accident I had no
ongoing treatment.
</page>
